name: Siguiri
#why: Siguiri Region, created by Guinea's decrees of 20 August 2026, read on national television and reported by leguideinfo.net (web:bbc4801eeb6cba7c) and laguinee.info (web:cc11f8ffad19945e): "les préfectures de Beyla et de Siguiri sont désormais érigées en régions administratives" (ruled 2026-10-20 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). It is GADM's Siguiri prefecture, GIN.4.5_1, carved out of Kankan Region. GN-S is a provisional code, to be replaced by ISO's once one exists.

name: Beyla
#why: Beyla Region, created by Guinea's decrees of 20 August 2026, read on national television and reported by leguideinfo.net (web:bbc4801eeb6cba7c) and laguinee.info (web:cc11f8ffad19945e): "les préfectures de Beyla et de Siguiri sont désormais érigées en régions administratives" (ruled 2026-10-20 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). It is GADM's Beyla prefecture, GIN.8.1_1, carved out of Nzérékoré Region, with the Kouankan sub-prefecture of Macenta, GIN.8.4.6_1, which the same decrees erect into a prefecture "dans la région administrative de Beyla" (reported by guineematin.com, web:d1e85e0894f3a726, and three others; the decree's text is not online; ruled 2026-10-21 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). Which other sub-prefectures the new prefecture takes is left to a ministerial act (its article 2), not yet found. GN-Y is a provisional code.

name: Djoué-Léfini
#why: Djoué-Léfini, created by Loi n° 25-2024 (Journal officiel n° 42-2024, web:44e306df8c64cffa) out of Pool (CG-12): the districts of Ignié, Mayama, Vinza, Kimba and Ngabé, COD-AB 2017 P-codes CG1103, CG1109, CG1113, CG1104 and CG1112 (Odziba, created by Loi n° 24-2024, lies inside Ngabé and Mayama as COD-AB draws them). Seat Odziba; Wikidata Q134457232. The Congo is drawn from Overture with its new departments cut out by COD-AB's districts (ruled 2026-10-20 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). CG-17 is a provisional code.

name: Nkéni-Alima
#why: Nkéni-Alima, created by Loi n° 26-2024 (Journal officiel n° 42-2024, web:44e306df8c64cffa) out of Plateaux (CG-14): the districts of Gamboma, Abala, Allembé, Ollombo, Ongoni and Makotipoko, COD-AB 2017 P-codes CG0904, CG0901, CG0902, CG0910, CG0911 and CG0906. Seat Gamboma; Wikidata Q134457202. The Congo is drawn from Overture with its new departments cut out by COD-AB's districts (ruled 2026-10-20 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). CG-18 is a provisional code.

name: Congo-Oubangui
#why: Congo-Oubangui, created by Loi n° 27-2024 (Journal officiel n° 42-2024, web:44e306df8c64cffa): the districts of Mossaka and Loukoléla, out of Cuvette (CG-8), and Liranga, out of Likouala (CG-7), COD-AB 2017 P-codes CG0304, CG0302 and CG0707 (Bokoma, created since, lies inside Mossaka as COD-AB draws it). Seat Mossaka; Wikidata Q134457230. The Congo is drawn from Overture with its new departments cut out by COD-AB's districts (ruled 2026-10-20 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). CG-19 is a provisional code.

name: Baku
#why: Baku (Bakı, Wikidata Q9248) is Overture division 827d1842-72b3-470a-8bf0-68c2002c2a83 gathered with the areas Overture files under it: Overture's first-level Baku is a 165 km2 core plus Karadag, and the city's other districts (Khazar, Sabunchu, Surakhani, Binagadi, Pirallahi) are locality areas under the city's division, 807 km2 of Azerbaijan that no first-level unit covered, measured 2026-09-14 against GADM's outline. Each gathered part is clipped to land no other unit already holds.

El Aricha Province (Wikidata Q139936248, DZ-63), created in 2025, which Overture draws while leaving Tlemcen's polygon (DZ-13) unchanged: El Aricha lies wholly inside Tlemcen as Overture draws it (3,012 of 3,012 km2), so Tlemcen is drawn less El Aricha.

Bamu Subdistrict, Overture division 984a9430-6b70-4a55-93ff-4e381c5e464e (143 km2), moved whole from Sulaymaniyah into Halabja Governorate: Law No. 7 of 2025 (Al-Waqai al-Iraqiya No. 4824, 5 May 2025, web:982302a070bc04d9) makes Bamo one of the governorate's subdistricts, one contiguous territory per the Ministry of Planning maps annexed to it, where Overture 2026-08-19.0 files it under Sulaymaniyah (ruled 2026-10-03 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). The governorate comes to about 1,164 km2 in one polygon (measured 2026-10-03).

The part of Darbandikhan Central, Overture division 3956dc2c-e51d-4836-8dc2-68d48081b188, inside COD-AB Iraq's (CSO, 2019) Markaz Halabja subdistrict, P-code IQG06Q05N03, about 128 km2: the Sirwan valley, the law's Sirwan arm meeting Bamo, moved into Halabja Governorate. Law No. 7 of 2025 (Al-Waqai al-Iraqiya No. 4824, 5 May 2025, web:982302a070bc04d9) makes the governorate one contiguous territory per the Ministry of Planning maps annexed to it, and Overture 2026-08-19.0 files the valley under Darbandikhan Central (ruled 2026-10-03 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj)). The governorate comes to about 1,164 km2 in one polygon (measured 2026-10-03).
